verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents self-hosting as a single binary with no external dependencies. It runs on Linux, macOS or Windows and installs via cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT or from source, with official Docker images, Helm charts and production deployment guidance. Independent self-hosters confirm this, running 80M documents on a Hetzner box and doing one-click Docker and k8s deployments. Missing for 10: evidence that replicated/high-availability clustering is available in the self-hosted free edition, since community reports say it is not in the free tier.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Meilisearch is a single binary with no external dependencies. You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.
Install Meilisearch locally on Linux, macOS, or Windows using cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or from source.
Helm charts for deploying Meilisearch on Kubernetes.
Official Meilisearch Docker images for easy deployment and development.
